Premise: CDSFL outputs are structured but extensible, and the parser comment itself claims “next all-caps section header,” not “next header from this finite list.” Concrete counterexample: if the block is followed by `DISCOVERY:` or `VERDICT:` on its own line, current code does not terminate at that line and may consume downstream text. Conclusion: the current implementation’s behavior is narrower than its stated contract and can silently misparse multi-section review text.
